lesson.goal: learn pandas: read a CSV, sort, filter and group data

sources.title: Complete Python Pandas Data Science Tutorial! (Reading CSV/Excel files, Sorting, Filtering, Groupby)

build.note: Hand-written test graph for server/workspace (no Gemini quota spent). Steps follow the tutorial's outline; no video timestamps claimed.

steps.title: Load the Pokemon CSV
steps.instructions: In main.py, import pandas and read pokemon_data.csv into a DataFrame called df, then print df.head(3).

steps.title: Read headers and rows
steps.instructions: Print df.columns, the Name column, and the row at index 1 with df.iloc[1].

steps.title: Sort by name and HP
steps.instructions: Sort df by Type 1 ascending and HP descending with sort_values.

steps.title: Add a Total column
steps.instructions: Add a Total column that sums HP, Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed.

steps.title: Filter Grass and Poison types
steps.instructions: Keep rows where Type 1 is Grass and Type 2 is Poison, and save them to filtered.csv.

steps.title: Group by type
steps.instructions: Group by Type 1 and show the mean Attack, sorted descending.
